items.difficulty_reason: For lqf f between smooth n-dimensional S-schemes: flatness by CM-over-regular, lci by permanence, the different equals the Kähler different computed from the exact sequence f*Omega_X -> Omega_Y -> Omega_{Y/X} -> 0 and the zeroth Fitting ideal of wedge^n(df), and at etale associated points R is an effective Cartier divisor with canonical isomorphism sending 1 to wedge^n df. Retained author proof at lines 2787-2814.
